topic: Intergenerational Solidarity Impact

In an urban neighborhood experiencing rapid nuclearization of families, an NGO establishes 'Aanand Day Care Centre for Senior Citizens'. topic: Impact of Rural Immersion on Youth Volunteers
questionText:
